Changes.change_log: Updated the Service Inventory fields to use the new Recombinant features `choices_reference_table` and `choices_fiscal_year`
Updated the Service Inventory triggers to query the new reference tables `ref_service_program_ids` and `ref_service_service_ids`
The temporary session pSQL table `datastore_user` (now `datastore_app_context`) now has an `org_name` column which is the Organization name/abbreviation that the Resource belongs to.
Refactored temporary session pSQL table `datastore_user` to `datastore_app_context`

Features.change_log: Added a bin script to generate Service Inventory Service IDs, Service Names, Program IDs, and Program Names (along with valid Organizations) for reference data from `https://github.com/gcperformance/service-data`. The data is tracked in CSV files in `ckanext.canada.tables.references.data`
Added a `service.sql` pSQL script for `recombinant.reference_definitions`. This creates the tables `ref_service_program_ids` and `ref_service_service_ids` along with some indices for them.
Added a new subcommand `load-ref-data` which loads any generated reference data into their custom DataStore tables. This is done via a pSQL copy expert, copying the CSVs directly into the tables.
Created a new `fiscal_year_error` pSQL function for the DataStore. This can dynamically validate fiscal year strings without needing to maintain a static list of them.
Added `choices_suffix_filter` capabilities to Recombinant Schemas. This allows for additional/universal suffix labels for select choice values.
Added dynamic pSQL boolean flags via the `datastore_app_context_flags` context parameter for the temp `datastore_app_context` table.

Changes.change_log: Optimize query performance by disabling Solr search highlighting parameters where search_text is either empty or wildcard.
